crossRefs.note: “You shall have no other gods before me.
for you shall worship no other god; for Yahweh, whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God.
“ ‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not…
and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of…
“You shall have no other gods before me.
Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that Yahweh spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,
Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of Yahweh your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image…
You shall not do so to Yahweh your God.

translations.web: and they served idols, of which Yahweh had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”
translations.bsb: They served idols, although the LORD had told them, “You shall not do this thing.”
translations.kjv: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
translations.asv: and they served idols, whereof Jehovah had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
